main: Craving a sweet breakfast without sugar, flour, or butter? These banana oat pancakes deliver! Just ripe bananas, eggs, and oats transform into a naturally sweet, satisfying stack perfect for a cozy weekend morning, reminiscent of a hotel breakfast spread.
reply1:
Ingredients for 6-7 pancakes:
• 2 ripe bananas (the more black spots, the sweeter!)
• 2 eggs
• 6 tablespoons oatmeal
Optional:
• A pinch of cinnamon powder
• A pinch of salt
reply2: Blend all ingredients for 30 seconds. Preheat pan over low heat; medium heat will burn the outside. Cook small pancakes, half a ladle each. Flip when bubbles appear.
alt_text: A stack of golden banana oat pancakes topped with a dollop of Greek yogurt, a drizzle of peanut butter, and banana slices. A cup of coffee sits beside the plate in bright, cozy morning light, captured in a realistic smartphone food photo.
